info.description: The Loyalty Expiration Information API provides access to real-time data about loyalty program expiration statuses. This endpoint allows developers to retrieve detailed information on when loyalty points or benefits are set to expire. Typical consumers of this API include loyalty program managers and customer relationship teams who wish to enhance customer engagement by prompting users regarding impending expirations. Use cases involve integrating this data into notifications or customer service platforms to encourage point usage before expiration.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch details related to the expiration of loyalty rewards. Use this to understand how soon your loyalty points or rewards will expire and take necessary actions.
